_note: 2권(단어 연못) 새 대본. 유닛 = 독립 4컷, 컷당 한 문장(그 유닛 단어 가족 + 사이트워드). 비즈(Beads)는 구슬 애벌레 친구로만. {BEADS} 사용 가능.
setting: A frame from a 3D animated film set at a sunny storybook pond in a garden: a round pond with lily pads, reeds, a wooden jetty, a few large rounded bushes and one willow tree, calm plain sky, soft lighting, limited palette of mint green, sky blue and sand.

panels.desc: {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} walk through a gap in the garden hedge and see a big round pond for the first time, eyes wide.
On a lily pad sits {BEADS}, a caterpillar made of five colored beads, waving a tiny hand. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} wave back from the bank.
{BEADS} clicks three of its beads together with a happy face; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} lean in to listen.
{PIP} tries to copy, clicking its beak; {BEADS} laughs; {BUN} and {HED} clap.
{cat} sleeps on a striped mat by the pond. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} tiptoe past with a paper fan.
panels.text: The cat is on the mat.

panels.desc: {rat} in a tiny hat creeps up and sits down on the sleeping cat's back; {PIP} covers its beak.
{cat} opens one eye; {rat} freezes; {BUN} and {HED} hold their breath. A toy van and a pan sit by the pond.
{cat} yawns and goes back to sleep; {rat} sleeps too, on the cat, on the mat. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} giggle. A bat hangs from the willow.
panels.text: The rat is on the cat on the mat!

panels.desc: {HED} wears a red cap and carries a big bag with a paper tag. {PIP} and {BUN} walk beside him on the jetty.
panels.text: Hedgie has a cap and a bag.

panels.desc: Wind blows the cap off Hedgie's head into the pond; it floats like a boat. A map falls out of the bag.
panels.text: My cap is in the pond!

panels.desc: {dog} splashes into the pond, grabs the cap in its mouth and swims back, tail wagging. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} cheer.
{dog} sits with the wet cap on its own head, proud; {HED} laughs and taps the dog. {PIP} naps in the bag.
panels.text: The cap is on the dog!

panels.desc: {hen} stands in a pen by the pond with nine more white hens: exactly ten hens. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} count them.
{BUN} holds a big fishing net; one hen hops out of the pen and gets tangled in the net. {HED} gasps.
{HED} pulls the hen out of the wet net gently; the hen is dripping. A toy jet lies on the bank; a vet bag sits nearby.
All ten hens sit in a row on the jetty drying in the sun; {PIP} sits at the end as the eleventh, pretending to be a hen. {BUN} and {HED} laugh.
{GRUMBLE} yawns on the pond bank with a pillow; there is no bed. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} look worried.
{BUN} and {HED} build a little bed from a red crate and a peg-board; {PIP} brings a leaf blanket.
{GRUMBLE} lies down; one leg hangs off the end of the too-small bed; {HED} looks at the leg.
panels.text: A leg! The bed is little.

panels.desc: {GRUMBLE} sleeps happily anyway, snoring, with his leg in the pond; a frog sits on his foot. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} tiptoe away.
{BEADS} lines up three big letter beads on the jetty; {PIP} looks at them. {cat} sleeps nearby.
{BEADS} clicks the beads together one by one; {PIP} listens with its beak open; {BUN} and {HED} watch.
{PIP} jumps up pointing at {cat} and shouts; the cat wakes up surprised.
{BUN}, {HED} and {BEADS} cheer and lift {PIP} up; {hen} and {dog} join the cheering.
{pig} digs a hole in the mud by the pond with its snout; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} watch. A fig lies on a plate.
{pig} lifts a shiny pin out of the mud on its snout; {HED} points.
{pig} digs again and pulls out a curly yellow wig; {BUN} laughs. A tin can sits beside the hole.
panels.text: A wig! The pig is big.

panels.desc: {pig} wears the wig with the pin in it, posing; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} clap. A fish fin pokes out of the pond.
panels.text: The pig can not dig. The pig can win!

panels.desc: {HED} tries to zip a bulging bag with a huge zipper; {PIP} and {BUN} push the bag closed.
The zipper rips open and a toy kit spills out: a ball, a kite and a cup. {HED} sits down on it.
{PIP} dips the bag's corner in the pond to clean it; a fish bites Pip's lip gently; Pip jumps.
The bag is zipped at last, with {PIP} sitting on top of it like a hat. {BUN} and {HED} give a thumbs up. A pit of sand is beside them.
Thick fog covers the pond; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} can only see shapes. A log floats on the water.
A dark shape moves in the fog; {HED} hides behind {BUN}; {PIP} peeks.
The shape comes closer: it is {dog} carrying a hot pot with steam. {BUN} relaxes. A cot stands on the jetty.
The fog clears; everyone sits on the log around the pot eating; a dot of soup is on Pip's beak.
{fox} drags a big box with a pop-up lid to the pond; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} watch curiously.
{fox} hops on top of the box; a mop and a spinning top fall out of it.
The lid pops open with a puff; {HED} jumps back; {PIP} flutters.
Out of the box climbs {ox}, a huge ox, far too big for it; {fox} looks amazed. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} laugh.
panels.text: We like the ox in the box!

panels.desc: A hot sunny day at the pond; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} lie on a rug in the sun with a mug of juice.
{bug} lands on {HED}'s nose; {HED} goes cross-eyed; {BUN} points.
{pup} runs up and gives {HED} a big hug, knocking him over; the bug flies away. A bun and a cup are on the rug.
Everyone piles on in a group hug on the rug, {PIP} on top; the pup licks Pip.
Lanterns hang over the pond; {PIP}, {BUN}, {HED} and {BEADS} set a table on the jetty with a pot, a mug and a bun.
Guests arrive: {cat} on a mat, {hen}, {pig} in a wig, {fox} on a box, {dog} with a cap. {HED} waves.
panels.text: The cat, the hen, the pig!

panels.desc: {GRUMBLE} arrives carrying his little red bed on his back, yawning. Everyone laughs kindly.
{GRUMBLE} sleeps in his bed in the middle of the party; everyone dances quietly around him in the sun; {PIP} sits on the bed.
A small stage on the jetty; {BEADS} hangs a string of big letter beads across it like a banner (plain colored beads, no writing). {PIP} wears a top hat.
{cat}, {pig} and {fox} each hold a blank white card; {BUN} and {HED} point at them from the side.
{GRUMBLE} on stage holds a card upside down, frowning, confused; the audience giggles.
{PIP} flips Grumble's card the right way up; Grumble smiles for the first time; everyone cheers.
